title: Task Force Arkansas Aids During Hurricane Harvey Aftermath
description:
The Arkansas National Guard has deployed nearly 1,500 Soldiers and Airmen to disaster stricken Texas. One of the many missions of the Arkansas Guardsmen is to provide manpower and logistical support at relief depots.

This video shows members of Task Force Aleutians, a smaller element of Task Force Arkansas, passing out essential household items to include food and water.

(U.S. Army National Guard by Spc. Stephen M. Wright)
